set.body: Progress events: stage (Estimating/Comparing/Reducing/Contrasting), done/total as Exact/AtMost/Unknown, cancel between steps. Run results carry plan revision and input digest so a stale completion is rejected. StudyPreview paging cheap enough to show exact eligible/unmatched/ambiguous counts, not only candidatePairCount until PairPage.Done.
set.title: UI-D: progress stages, stale-result rejection and exact preview counts
